title: Computation under Rapidly Vanishing Navier–Stokes Forcing
main_claim: For fixed computable ν>0, from a Turing machine M and an input w one can effectively build a smooth force on R^3, supported in the fixed compact set K, with every mixed derivative decaying faster than any power of t. The Navier–Stokes solution starting from rest is then explicit and unique, with zero pressure, and the particle starting at the origin reaches X_1<-1 iff M halts on w. The paper also gives a torus version with solenoidal force (Corollary), an alternating-coordinate version (Thm 4.1) and a periodic lattice version (Thm 5.1).
coverage: Thm 3.1 checked line by line. Configuration code: k_n<M_n and j<=2n<P_n. Transition formula F_n: the digit replacement, the shift by A, the head index j+d+1, and the range F_n<M_{n+1}. Scales: L_n=L_0+n(1+2r_A)<=C(n+1), s_n>=16C(n+1), s_{n+1}/s_n=2^{2n+5}>=32(n+1). From these: the total-memory sum is <1, b_n<=δ_n^{n+10}<δ_n/8, and δ_j/δ_n is divisible by M_n (needs s_n-L_n>=s_j). The read identity m mod M_n=k_n. Disjoint supports: the strips |x_2-mδ_n| are all under δ_n/4. Rescaling check: V = b_n times a fixed profile with parameters η,ξ in [-1,1]^3. Residual derivative exponents n+8-|α| and 2n+19-|α|. ODE identification at the curl plateau, the halting signal -1-b_n, and the loading segment staying inside K. Torus corollary: λK+c sits inside the cube, the slab (1/4,3/8) catches 3/8-b_n/8, and the curl potential gives mean zero. Also checked, in less detail: alternating section (divisibility of earlier blocks, decoder P on [0,m], the left-move stack update, curl plateau velocities (0,L,E)/(L,0,E), signal from -ε_n to ±ε_{n+1}, C^r estimate). Lattice section (stack ops and bounds in Lemma 5.2, K_n divisibility and plateau bound, signal 1/2±β_{n+1}, divergence cancellation in the z-lift). The analytic lemmas (realization/uniqueness, effective projection) are cited from a companion paper and were not re-proved.
sibling_notes: Family 376 siblings (rank 453 and rank 328) also reported no_gap_found on similar residual-realization constructions. This paper relies on companion Lemmas 1 and 3 (CompanionA) for realization/uniqueness and the effective solenoidal projection. Those are standard, and nothing circular was seen.
